question.title: Furthest Channels of the Delta
question.content:
A river delta is a tree. Each channel has a flow value val and a list children of the channels it splits into, in order from left to right.

Return the values of the channels furthest from spring, in order from left to right. These are all the channels on the deepest level of the tree.

Test case format:

The tree is shown in level order. Each group of children follows the groups before it and ends with a null separator, so a channel with no children gives an empty group. The first value is spring, whose own group ends at the first null.

 

Example 1:

Input: spring = [2,null,8,5,null,1,null,7,13]
Output: [1,7,13]
Explanation: 2 splits into 8 and 5. 8 splits into 1, and 5 splits into 7 and 13.

Example 2:

Input: spring = [6]
Output: [6]

Example 3:

Input: spring = [4,null,9,null,12,10,null,null,14]
Output: [14]
Explanation: 4 splits into 9, and 9 splits into 12 and 10. 12 has no children, and 10 splits into 14.

 

Constraints:

  • The number of channels is in the range [1, 104].
  • 0 <= Node.val <= 104
  • spring is never null.
